external.title: The Algorithmic Beauty of Plants (Prusinkiewicz & Lindenmayer, 1990)
external.author: Przemyslaw Prusinkiewicz, Aristid Lindenmayer

technique_notes.repeat_zone_vs_simulation: Repeat Zone collapses all N iterations into one depsgraph pass; Iterations is a live parameter. Simulation Zone writes one timestep per playback frame.
technique_notes.curveline_trick: CurveLine(end=branch_offset) + CurveToMesh bakes direction into instance local geometry — no AlignEulerToVector needed.
technique_notes.items_mechanism: Items added to RepeatOutput.items create paired sockets on both RepeatInput and RepeatOutput. RepeatInput.inputs[0]='Iterations', items start at [1].
technique_notes.vertex_budget: 5 iterations × 3-branch → 363 tubes × 14 verts ≈ 5 100 verts. Draco 6 typically compresses to under 120 KB.
